scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run dev -w @milo/api" "npm run dev -w @milo/web" "npm run dev -w @milo/worker"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker "npm run start -w @milo/api" "npm run start -w @milo/web" "npm run start -w @milo/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @milo/shared && npm run build -w @milo/api && npm run build -w @milo/worker && npm run build -w @milo/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.assets:models: node scripts/build-collection-models.mjs && node scripts/build-legacy-models.mjs && node scripts/render-legacy-images.mjs
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/domain.test.ts tests/media.test.ts tests/photo-spin.test.ts tests/garment-palette.test.ts && node --test tests/sync-project.test.mjs tests/garment-geometry.test.mjs
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml up -d --wait postgres redis
scripts.infra:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml stop postgres redis
scripts.infra:status: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml ps postgres redis
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml logs --tail=100 postgres redis
